issues.legal_issue: A notice communicating that an award has been made and stating the compensation awarded is valid even if it omits the detailed basis for calculating compensation, and receipt of that notice starts the limitation period for seeking a reference.
material_facts: A person interested in acquired land received a notice of the award that stated the compensation amount; the acquired area was not disputed.
The notice did not explain the details or method used to determine the compensation.
The person received compensation under protest but applied for a reference after the applicable six-week period had expired.
issues.conclusion: The notice was valid despite omitting the detailed basis for the compensation. Limitation began when it was received, so the reference application was time-barred; the appeal was allowed and the High Court’s order was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 11 and 12(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, the award determines matters including the land’s area, compensation and apportionment, and is conclusive between the Collector and interested persons. Section 12(2) requires immediate notice of the award to persons not present or represented when it is made; the notice need only communicate that the award has been made and need not include all its details or the method of valuation. A person receiving compensation under protest may inspect the award or obtain a certified copy before stating objections in a reference application under section 18(1). Under section 18(2), the applicable limitation period runs from receipt of the notice; it does not depend on the notice being communicated in a particular form where no form is prescribed. Section 31 is relevant to receipt of compensation under protest. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: land_acquisition_reference_proceeding and notice_received and notice_identifies_award_and_compensation and award_calculation_details_omitted and compensation_received_under_protest and reference_application_after_deadline

predicates.land_acquisition_reference_proceeding: The proceeding seeks a court reference concerning compensation for acquired land.
predicates.notice_received: The interested person received a notice communicating that the award had been made.
predicates.notice_identifies_award_and_compensation: The notice identified the award and stated the compensation amount.
predicates.award_calculation_details_omitted: The notice omitted the detailed basis or method used to calculate compensation.
predicates.compensation_received_under_protest: The interested person received the compensation while objecting to the award.
predicates.reference_application_after_deadline: The interested person applied for a reference after the applicable limitation period had expired.

issues.definition: When an interested person in a land-acquisition reference proceeding receives a notice identifying the award and compensation, omission of the calculation details does not prevent the notice from starting limitation, and an application filed after the deadline is time-barred.
